results.question: What is the annual financial assistance provided under PM-KISAN?
results.answer: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Operational Guidelines The PM-KISAN scheme is a Central Sector Scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families across the country to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs. Under the Scheme, an amount of Rs 6,000/- per year is released in three 4-monthly installments of Rs 2,000/- each directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

results.question: What are the age and assistance criteria under the senior citizen pension scheme?
results.answer: The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) is a non-contributory pension scheme under the Ministry of Rural Development aimed at providing monthly financial assistance to senior citizens living Below Poverty Line (BPL). INDIRA GANDHI NATIONAL OLD AGE PENSION SCHEME (IGNOAPS) GUIDELINES For persons aged 60 to 79 years: Central assistance of Rs 200 per month per beneficiary (States supplement this with an additional state share, making the total pension between Rs 1,000 to Rs 2,500 per month).
